name: Felsőpakony (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőpakony: a blue shield with a yellow bee, an arrow and ears of grain, supported by two yellow stags, above a scroll inscribed FELSŐPAKONY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Felsőpakony arms with stag supporters and scroll
